messages.subject: postgres and ntile
parts:
Hello --

I have a table in a Postgres 9.4 database with the following columns (y are 0/1)
    model_matrix(individual_id int8, varid int2, value int2, y int2)

I am trying to figure out at what point to winsorize each of the variables.

require(dplyr)
require(tidyr)

ptile <- model_matrix %>% select(-individual_id) %>% #as.data.frame(n=-1) %>%
    group_by(varid,y) %>% mutate(tile=ntile(value,100)) %>%
    group_by(varid,y,tile) %>% summarise(value=max(value)) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    filter(tile %in% c(5,25,50,75,seq(95,100))) %>% spread(tile,value,fill=0)

When I run the above, I get ""function ntile(numeric) does not exit"".  If I remove the comment for as.data.frame() on the first line (the dataframe is being read into memory), it runs fine.

It does seem that ntile is a function in Postgres.  Any idea what the issue may be?

Thanks.

messages.subject: Re: postgres and ntile
parts:
Here's some code to create the instance:

#create dataset
require(dplyr)
require(tidyr)

set.seed(100)
nind <- 200
nvar <- 8
nrow.init <- 1000
mm <- data.frame(individual_id=sample(1:nind,nrow.init,replace=TRUE),varid=sample(1:nvar,nrow.init,replace=TRUE)) %>% unique(.) %>%
    mutate(value=rpois(n(),5), y=as.integer(runif(n())>0.8)) %>% arrange(individual_id,varid)

#load data into postgres
require(RPostgreSQL)
conn_pg <- dbConnect(dbDriver("PostgreSQL"), host="localhost", dbname="shiny", port="5433", user="postgres", password="postgresql")
dbWriteTable(conn_pg, "model_matrix", mm, row.name=FALSE, overwrite=TRUE)
dbDisconnect(conn_pg)


#compute ntile
conn <- src_postgres(host="localhost", dbname="shiny", port="5433", user="postgres", password="postgresql")
mm.pg <- tbl(conn, "model_matrix")
identical(mm, mm.pg %>% as.data.frame(n=-1))

#works
mm %>% group_by(varid,y) %>% mutate(tile=ntile(value,10))
mm.pg %>% group_by(varid,y) %>% as.data.frame(n=-1) %>% mutate(tile=ntile(value,10))
#does not work
mm.pg %>% group_by(varid,y) %>% mutate(tile=ntile(value,10))

> mm.pg %>% group_by(varid,y) %>% mutate(tile=ntile(value,10))

messages.subject: Re: postgres and ntile
parts:
I used the show_query() functionality to get the SQL query which was getting created and ran that query in Postgres.  The query generated is

select "individual_id", "varid", "value", "y" NTILE(10.0) over (PARTITION BY ("varid","y") ORDER BY "value") as "tile"
from model_matrix

The problem is that NTILE needs an integer.  So, when I changed the above code to NTILE(10) and ran in Postgres console, it ran just fine.
